# research-lab

> A self-learning harness for Claude Code: a 13-agent delivery pipeline (plan, critique, TDD under a verify gate, fresh-context review and merge gate) that turns user corrections, review findings and escaped bugs into evidence-backed lessons, new reviewer agents and new skills, a hypothesis-driven research loop with an independent reviewer, plus a self-routing local knowledge base (hybrid search, GraphRAG, corrective RAG, contextual retrieval, reranking, incremental updates) and a topic-map router and a skill/MCP gap radar. Python standard library only; installs as a Claude Code plugin or via install.sh.

## Start here
- [README](README.md): what it does, quick start, components
- [Learning loop](docs/learning-loop.md): signals, lessons, promotion ladder, "missed a bug? add a reviewer"
- [Knowledge router](docs/knowledge-router.md): building the knowledge base with its router, budgets
- [Pipeline](docs/pipeline.md): /feature roles, modes and artifacts
- [Hooks](docs/hooks.md): every hook, its event, scope and environment variables
- [Components](docs/components.md): every agent, skill, hook and script
- [Comparison](docs/comparison.md): dated comparison with related projects

## Components
- [agents/](agents/): al-planner, al-plan-critic, al-code-scout, al-docs-scout, al-implementer, al-test-writer, al-code-reviewer, al-doc-writer, al-merge-gate, al-lessons-keeper, al-escape-analyst, al-skill-scout, rl-hypothesis-reviewer
- [skills/](skills/): feature, research, merge-check, learn, retro, skill-radar, knowledge-search, knowledge-ingest, colleague-message, pr-description, git-handoff
- [hooks/](hooks/): check_secrets, capture_feedback, session_brief, verify_gate, test_output_filter, planner_guard
- [templates/](templates/): CLAUDE.md routing table, topic map, required docs, lessons, message style
